description: qmd's cold-start progress output on stdout is a broken contract, not an empty corpus. The bytes replayed here are what qmd's renderer really writes; reading them as no-results would turn a 2GB model download into a successful empty search.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory, which holds the recorded qmd output and the corpus evidence is read from
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
